item.title: The anatomy of a personal health agent
item.description: A personal health agent coordinates data analysis, health expertise and coaching to improve evaluated conversational support over single-agent and parallel-agent baselines, without establishing long-term health benefits. English two-host technical deep dive (NotebookLM). Paper: Heydari, A. Ali et al., 10.1038/s41586-026-11161-8Version of record, 2026-10-21 — https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-11161-8

item.title: HEARTS: Benchmarking LLM Reasoning on Health Time Series
item.description: HEARTS benchmarks code-using language-model agents across diverse physiological time-series tasks and finds that strong general reasoning scores do not reliably translate into accurate, data-grounded temporal analysis. English two-host technical deep dive (NotebookLM). Paper: Sirui Li et al., arXiv:2603.06638v3 — https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06638v3

item.title: Generalist vs Specialist Time Series Foundation Models: Investigating Potential Emergent Behaviors in Assessing Human Health Using PPG Signals
item.description: Across a broad PPG benchmark, MOMENT offers stronger classification and regression domain transfer, while PPG-GPT wins more regression comparisons after adaptation, with neither consistently outperforming simple clinical baselines. English two-host technical deep dive (NotebookLM). Paper: Saurabh Kataria et al., arXiv:2510.14254v1 — https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.14254v1

item.title: PPG-Bench: A Unified Benchmark for PPG Foundation Models
item.description: PPG-Bench standardizes evaluation of five PPG foundation models across diverse datasets and adaptation regimes, finding that their released representations often fail to beat simple physiological features or a generic time-series model. English two-host technical deep dive (NotebookLM). Paper: Arvasu Kulkarni et al., arXiv:2610.13435v1 — https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13435v1

item.title: Harness^2: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World
item.description: Harness^2 improves frozen-model agents on unseen tasks by contrasting executions of proposed harness edits, composing supported changes, and retaining reusable refinement experience to guide future tasks without ground-truth feedback during adaptation. English two-host technical deep dive (NotebookLM). Paper: Ruiyao Xu et al., arXiv:2610.14224v1 — https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14224v1
